reading.title: Working from anywhere
reading.text: Since 2020, remote working has become normal for millions of office staff. Surveys suggest that many employees feel more motivated at home, where they can organise their own day. Managers, however, worry that people who are rarely in the office are less likely to be promoted, because their work is less visible. Psychologists add an emotional factor: workers who live alone can feel isolated. Meanwhile, mobile technology means that the line between work and private life is becoming harder to draw. For many companies, the solution is a hybrid model with two or three office days a week.

items.s: All employees feel more motivated when they work at home.
Remote workers are paid less than office workers.
Many companies have chosen a mix of home and office days.
